body:
Founder real-time: 'MISHRI forked from an unknown author please update it to build with bazel and also the artifacts to include a construct file the concatination check parena editor out for an example' -> 'the author isnt unknown there is a github they are just outside the organization' -> 'use at own risk all that' -> 'update readme to aknowledge the author and the ambiguous licensing situation'. Shipped: real Bazel build (MODULE.bazel/BUILD.bazel, .bazelversion pinned 9.2.0, rules_shell dep) with bazel test //:test as a real hermetic test of the humanness layer + skin manager (no npm install needed), bazel run //:install/:mishri as documented non-hermetic npm wrappers; new .github/workflows/ci.yml with a real Bazel test gate + a Generate Construct Bundle step matching PARENA's own exact convention (3 uploaded artifacts: txt/tar.gz/zip), verified locally (24-file bundle, well-formed markers); README Author & License section crediting the real, known original author (github.com/arpitrajjj, external to this org) and noting the real ambiguous ISC-declared-but-no-LICENSE-file situation plus a use-at-your-own-risk note; own CLAUDE.md added; registered in the top-level CLAUDE.md repo table (MONOREPO commit bb77f2e). MISHRI commits 66825b5/810bb9a/19fb2a4.

⚓ ☃
title: Bazel build + CI construct bundle + honest attribution shipped
